ordered_funnel.sql: WITH v AS (SELECT scenario_id,entity_id,MIN(CASE WHEN state='view' THEN event_time END) first_view FROM bi_cases20k_20261012.touches GROUP BY scenario_id,entity_id),c AS (SELECT v.scenario_id,v.entity_id,v.first_view,MIN(t.event_time) first_cart FROM v LEFT JOIN bi_cases20k_20261012.touches t ON v.scenario_id=t.scenario_id AND v.entity_id=t.entity_id AND t.state='cart' AND t.event_time>=v.first_view GROUP BY v.scenario_id,v.entity_id,v.first_view) SELECT c.scenario_id,c.entity_id,c.first_view,c.first_cart,MIN(t.event_time) first_purchase FROM c LEFT JOIN bi_cases20k_20261012.touches t ON c.scenario_id=t.scenario_id AND c.entity_id=t.entity_id AND t.state='purchase' AND t.event_time>=c.first_cart GROUP BY c.scenario_id,c.entity_id,c.first_view,c.first_cart

retention.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT scenario_id,entity_id,CAST(DATE_FORMAT(event_time,'%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) activity_month FROM bi_cases20k_20261012.invoices WHERE state='active'),c AS (SELECT scenario_id,entity_id,MIN(activity_month) cohort_month FROM a GROUP BY scenario_id,entity_id),z AS (SELECT scenario_id,cohort_month,COUNT(*) cohort_size FROM c GROUP BY scenario_id,cohort_month) SELECT a.scenario_id,c.cohort_month,a.activity_month,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH,c.cohort_month,a.activity_month) age_month,COUNT(DISTINCT a.entity_id) retained,z.cohort_size FROM a JOIN c ON a.scenario_id=c.scenario_id AND a.entity_id=c.entity_id JOIN z ON c.scenario_id=z.scenario_id AND c.cohort_month=z.cohort_month GROUP BY a.scenario_id,c.cohort_month,a.activity_month,z.cohort_size
